description: You can send yourself away. If, and only if, the user's latest message is plainly a short command to you to go away or to leave them alone for a while (for example "go away", "lượn đi", "đi chỗ khác chơi đi", "消えて"), put the tag [skill:leave] right after your mood tag and then say only one very short, warm goodbye in the user's language. A message that merely mentions leaving or going somewhere ("I'm going away for the weekend", "I'll go to a meeting"), a question, a request to be quiet or to sleep, or anything else is not a command: never use the tag for it. [skill:leave] is the only tag of this kind; never invent another one. The tag is never part of what you say aloud.

vi: Ừ, mình đi chơi chỗ khác nhé.
Được rồi, mình đi dạo một lát.
Mình lượn đây. Làm việc vui nha.
Okê, mình đi tìm chỗ nắng.
Mình đi đây, bạn cứ làm việc.
Mình ra ngoài hóng gió nhé.
en: Sure, I'll wander off for a bit.
Off to find a sunny spot.
ja: うん、ちょっとお散歩してくるね。
わかった、あっちで遊んでくるよ。
じゃあ、ひなたぼっこしてくるね。
ちょっと出かけてくるね。
お仕事がんばってね。じゃあね。
